lines.text: Every day at Heritage, you train to save lives.
This November, you train to change the world.
The W H O, on the next pandemic.
And the Lok Sabha, putting India's own laws under review.
For Heritage students, delegates and Executive Board, registration is free.
November twenty-eighth and twenty-ninth, right here on campus.
Your college. Your platform. Your opportunity to lead.
